item.title: Bank of England expected to raise interest rates for first time since 2023
item.body: The Bank of England is expected to raise interest rates for the first time in more than three years. Many economists think rate-setters will want to tackle rising inflation in the UK by tightening monetary policy, which could squeeze borrowers.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 📈 Bank of England expected to raise interest rates for first time since 2023

The Bank of England is expected to raise interest rates for the first time in more than three years. Many economists think rate-setters will want to tackle rising inflation in the UK by tightening monetary policy, which could squeeze borrowers.

Source: Nation.Cymru / Press Associati | Image: Pixabay
